name: pucks_mfcc-logmel_logistic

output.class_index: index into classes; use this rather than score argmax for SVC vote ties

contract.window: three equally spaced4s nonoverlapping windows; model accepts one window feature vector; majority file/game vote outside model

license.distributed_pdf_license_verbatim: The dataset is provided for evaluation purpose under the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International License ("by-sa").
license.decision: Local research evaluation only; do not redistribute raw/derived dataset or assume production permissions. Clarification required for license conflict.
license.groups: Each vol_000/050/100 x puck_A/E/G/I has five three-minute games with three patch-0/1/2 minute files. IDs usually 00..04, but PA2200/G at vol050 uses 00,01,02,09,10. Actual IDs are parsed, not assumed sequential; all patches and both channels grouped before splitting.
license.player_puck_ids: PDF says different player sets and pucks per game; no persistent player or physical-puck identity mapping in filename or release documentation. Game is the strongest observable group, not independently verified puck-held-out evaluation.
license.known_material_decision: Exclude puck_A unknown factory material and no_puck backgrounds; evaluate ABS/FDM, PA2200/SLS, PA12/MJF. Material and manufacturing process remain confounded.

contract.limits: Game grouping not physical-puck independence; unknown puck_A excluded

training.selection: both fixed C=1 families retained, no outer-score winner selection

performance_claim: Deployment fitted on every cached observation. No deployment training-set accuracy presented as held-out performance.

verification_fixture.schema: features float32[N,D], scores float64[N,K], class_index int32[N], classes[K], source_indices[N]; <=8 real rows
